 II. m.
 1. The elephant of the west or southwest quarter.
 2. The name of a mountain.
 3. A particular plant, Pañc. 10, 7.
 III. f. ना. The name of a female monkey, the mother of Hanumant.
 --Comp.
आञ्जन, i. e. आ-अञ्ज् + अन, n. and f. नी, Ointment.

अञ्जलि, m.
 1. The cavity formed by putting the hands together and hollowing the palms,

. This cavity as measure: two handfuls.
 3. Putting the hands together and raising them to the forehead, as humble salutation of inferiors to their superiors.
 --Comp.
